_comment: Chapter -> RMXP map-id binding: the SoT (CLAUDE.md 4.3) for what maps a
play-order unit covers. Acts are the Game_Walkthrough page's own top-level
sections; chapters are its location units (a town plus its interiors, or a
route plus its side rooms). Chapter == slice == one section-9 boot gate ==
A location visited again later is a SEPARATE chapter with visit > 1 over the
same map ids, so map ids are deliberately NOT unique across chapters.
Wiki names and ordering come from output/uranium-build/wiki/Game_Walkthrough.wiki
(refetch: python scripts/fetch_uranium_wiki.py). Map membership is decided by
output/uranium-build/map_infos.json plus the warp graph and connections.json --
NEVER by the wiki, per ROM_TEST_DEV.md Branch A1(b). Recorded disagreements

chapters.title: Moki Town
chapters.notes: The pathfinder slice (chapters replaced slices as the work unit 2026-08-05; same unit, same gate). Map roster matches tileset_converter/map_set.py:30 SLICE_MAP_IDS exactly. Passed its §9 boot-walk gate 2026-08-04 (moki chapter suite GREEN 17/17). Live doc: reference/chapters/01-moki.md; SLICE1_TODO.md is retired to reference/archive/, open items migrated to PROJECT_TODO.md/CH02_TODO.md/ROM_TEST_DEV.md.

chapters.title: Route 1
chapters.notes: Active frontier. Spec reference/chapters/02-route-1.md; work checklist CH02_TODO.md (blocked on #4, per-map tileset packing). 81 = 'Route 01 (old rod house)'; the act-boundary worry is resolved -- the Old Rod is a forward, same-act, cross-chapter gate (item sits in CH02, locked on VAR_BATTLE_VAR01 which only CH06/Map042 writes), see 02-route-1.md §7.

chapters.title: Kevlar Town
chapters.notes: Map 19 'Passage Cave' is bound HERE, not to CH05: the warp graph shows it connects only to/from Kevlar (31) in both directions and never reaches Route 02 or Nowtoch. Naive parent-tree reading would have mis-assigned it. Introduces the bike (Bike Repair Shop / Bike Wheel).

chapters.title: Route 2
chapters.notes: Seams (connections.json): 31 N<->S 35, and 35 N<->S 40. The direct Route 02 -> Nowtoch overland seam exists in data but the wiki says it is rockslide-blocked until Rock Smash, so the first pass is forced through Passage Cave.

chapters.title: Passage Cave
chapters.notes: Traversal confirmed by warp graph: 35 -> 36 <-> 37 -> 40. First dungeon; first candidate for cave/Flash handling. In the wiki this unit is a raw <h3> tag, not a '===' heading.

chapters.title: Nowtoch City
chapters.notes: Gym 1 (map 42). First Gym, first metro/Tandor-Underground station (44, 45), and the Rock Smash grant. Novelty-promoted.

chapters.title: Route 2 (revisit)
chapters.notes: Rock Smash clears the rockslide; the overland 35<->40 seam becomes usable.

chapters.title: Moki Town (revisit)
chapters.notes: Same maps as CH01 at a later story state. First proof that the revisit-as-own-chapter model works: no new conversion, only new gate states.

chapters.title: Route 3
chapters.notes: Reached via the Moki Town E <-> Route 03 seam (connections.json 32 E <-> 59 W). CH01 only proved the seam fails cleanly (SLICE1_TODO #9); converting it -- the first of 14 connections.dat seams -- is PROJECT_TODO.md #27, off-frontier because this chapter is 7 chapters past CH02.

chapters.title: Burole Town
chapters.notes: Gym 2 (map 66). NOTE: the wiki's own location navigation omits Burole entirely and mis-numbers later gyms; the walkthrough body and the map tree agree with each other. See atlas discrepancy list.

chapters.title: Rochfale Town
chapters.notes: Has NO Gym map -- it has Cypress Lab (98). The wiki navigation calling it 'Gym 4' is wrong. Seam: 12 W <-> 22 E.

chapters.title: Nuclear Plant Epsilon
chapters.notes: DATA-DERIVED, not wiki-derived: the walkthrough gives Epsilon no location heading and a sub-agent read it as never entered, but the warp graph shows 122 <-> 8 (Route 07) in BOTH directions plus 122 <-> 123 and 122 <-> 125. Bound as its own chapter off Route 07. Verify the entry gate against event data before writing beats.

chapters.title: Bealbeach City
chapters.notes: Gym 3 spans three maps (102 + 103 'Gym3.1' + 124 'Gym3'). Largest interior roster in the game: department store with an elevator (58), Rangers HQ (156), metro (3, 11), resort/casino (52).

chapters.title: Tandor Luxury Cruise
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: a scripted vehicle/ferry sequence with no obvious Emerald analog beyond the SS Tidal. Map identity confirmed by warp graph -- 155 'Route 08(Cruise)' warps only to/from 117.

chapters.title: Route 8
chapters.notes: Seam: 117 N <-> 28 S. Good Rod is granted here.

chapters.title: Vinoville Town
chapters.notes: Gym 4 spans 148 + 162.

chapters.title: Legen Town
chapters.notes: Three metro maps (129, 168, 201) plus a 'VR building' (20).

chapters.title: Route 11
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: HM04 Strength grant -- a new traversal capability that gates later revisit chapters.

chapters.title: Route 5 (revisit)
chapters.notes: Optional Strength-gated side trip; the wiki presents it as an aside, not critical path.

chapters.title: Route 9
chapters.notes: Optional; day-care / breeding content. Off critical path.

chapters.title: Route 10 / Anthell
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: a dungeon traversed twice with an item-gated wall between passes (Anthell 150 -> Anthell Deeper 83), plus an uncatchable boss battle.

chapters.title: Amatree Town
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: Gym 5 (69), a barter economy with no currency shop, and the HM03 Surf grant -- the single largest traversal unlock in the game.

chapters.title: Route 10 (revisit)
chapters.notes: Surf shortcut.

chapters.title: Route 4 (revisit)
chapters.notes: Surf-gated shoreline.

chapters.title: Comet Cave (revisit)
chapters.notes: Surf-only back entrance into the same dungeon; the wiki's 'Fossil Sidequest cave' is not a separate map.

chapters.title: Bealbeach City (revisit)
chapters.notes: Optional.

chapters.title: Legen Town (revisit)
chapters.notes: Optional; grants the Surfboard and Power Glove -- item-form substitutes for HM field moves, a conversion question worth an early verdict.

chapters.title: Route 13 (revisit)
chapters.notes: UNCERTAIN BINDING: the wiki calls this approach corridor 'Maskara Island', a name with no match in map_infos.json. Route 13 is a context match only -- confirm from map data before relying on it.

chapters.title: The Labyrinth
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: first underwater map (107) and the first Mega Stone. Contains a Dive-gated room that cannot be finished on this visit.

chapters.title: Route 15
chapters.notes: Super Rod grant. Seam: 134 S <-> 133 N.

chapters.title: Silverport Town
chapters.notes: Has NO Gym map -- it has a Lab (75). The wiki navigation calling it 'Gym 8' is wrong.

chapters.title: Lanthanite Cave
chapters.notes: 202 'Lanthanite Core' is Waterfall-gated and not reachable on this visit.

chapters.title: Route 16
chapters.notes: Ice-slide puzzles -- check whether the fork's ice metatile behaviors cover them.

chapters.title: Snowbank Town
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: Gym 7 spans FOUR maps (136, 137, 141, 206) as a multi-trial gauntlet, and this chapter unlocks Mega Evolution and grants HM08 Dive. Seam: 136 S <-> 135 N.

chapters.title: Venesi City (revisit)
chapters.notes: Dive departure point.

chapters.title: Route 14
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: Dive-gated surface/underwater map pair (99 / 118). Seams: 144 E <-> 99 W, 146 W <-> 99 E.

chapters.title: Tsukinami Village
chapters.notes: Gym 8 (175) is a dual-leader fight.

chapters.title: Nuclear Plant Omicron
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: sequential scripted battles and the HM02 Fly grant. Nuclear-type content -- the one mechanic reference/guides/nuclear_type_spec.md says is genuinely new C.

chapters.title: Route 8 (Nuclear) / Hazard Zone
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted. Distinct maps from CH22's Route 8 (187 vs 117) -- a hazard-zone variant of the same route, not a revisit. 'Hazard Zone' is a mechanic label with no map of that name.

chapters.title: Nuclear Plant Zeta
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: five-map compass-arranged complex (South/Outside/East/West/North) plus hazmat-suit gating.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.notes: Six maps: outdoor, cave, secret garden, bridge, volcano, apex.

chapters.title: Championship Site
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: a randomised bracket drawn from the earlier Gym Leaders (VAR_TANDOR_CHAMPIONSHIP_LIST / _ROUND are already pre-seeded in essentials_to_emerald_map.md), across nine maps including two arenas and a flashback.

chapters.title: Hall of Fame
chapters.notes: Credits sequence.

chapters.title: Moki Town (postgame)
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted only because it is where the postgame pages on slice-1 maps finally fire -- exactly the switch-125 'FINAL EVENT' grants that reference/chapters/01-moki.md section 4.2 rules out of CH01 (Lava Cookie on 49, Poke Radar on 50, HM07 Waterfall on 172). Writing this chapter validates CH01's postgame exclusions.

chapters.title: Dream World (Sleeping Girl Sidequest)
chapters.notes: Novelty-promoted: an entire 13-map optional subtree, the only content in the game the walkthrough reaches through a sidequest section rather than the main chain. Entry triggers in CH49.
